summaryEn: Use only public rotorcraft context to learn actuator disks, transmissions, vibration and material verification in non-flying models, excluding weapons, military-performance desi…

titleEn: Submarine Context and Underwater Vehicle Engineering
summary: 從國造潛艦的公開科普入口轉向民用水下載具的浮力、配重與科學量測；比較常壓浮體模型與實際壓力邊界，練習辨識不能從桌面算例推論的事項。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。

title: 矽光子與 CPO 光引擎

title: 蒸汽火車頭工程
summary: 用熱力循環和非加壓機構模型理解鍋爐、汽缸、連桿、輪軌與維修。
summaryEn: Use thermodynamic concepts and unpressurized mechanism models to understand boiler, cylinder, rods, wheel-rail interaction and maintenance.

title: 法拉利與精密汽車製造
summary: 以公開工廠案例理解車身、動力、底盤、塗裝與品質追溯；所有組裝動作以虛擬模型呈現。
summaryEn: Use public factory examples to study body, powertrain, chassis, finishing and quality traceability through virtual assembly.

title: 特斯拉與電動汽車工程
summary: 以電池、驅動、熱管理、車身與軟體的整體整合為主線，建立安全的虛擬製造學習流程。
summaryEn: Study battery, drive, thermal, body and software integration in a safe virtual manufacturing workflow.

title: DART 行星防禦任務的成功判準
titleEn: Success criteria for DART planetary defense
summary: 將「造成可偵測偏轉」拆成週期變化、觀測時窗和證據的需求。
summaryEn: Decompose detectable deflection into requirements for period change, observing windows and evidence.

title: 火星氣候探測者的單位介面與追溯
titleEn: Unit interfaces and traceability in Mars Climate Orbiter
summary: 建立可執行的單位契約，測試發送者與接收者對同一筆脈衝的解讀。
summaryEn: Define an executable unit contract and test how sender and receiver interpret the same impulse.

title: 阿波羅 13 號故障隔離與生存資源
titleEn: Fault isolation and survival resources on Apollo 13
summary: 在有限氧氣與電能下排定不可中斷負載、可延後負載與重新啟動門檻。
summaryEn: Prioritize essential loads, deferrable loads and restart thresholds within finite oxygen and energy.

title: 羅曼太空望遠鏡巡天架構取捨
summary: 由指定巡天面積反推曝光數、重疊損失和機動開銷。
summaryEn: Derive exposure count, overlap loss and maneuver overhead for a specified survey area.

title: 韋伯望遠鏡部署狀態與試驗證據
titleEn: Webb deployment states and verification evidence
summary: 把高風險展開事件畫成具有互鎖、等待及證據的狀態機。
summaryEn: Map high-risk deployments into a state machine with interlocks, holds and evidence.

title: 毅力號樣本鏈與空白對照
titleEn: Perseverance sample custody and witness controls
summary: 建立可追蹤封存、採樣地點和封存狀態的電子交接鏈。
summaryEn: Design a chain of custody linking seal, site and custody state.

title: 哨兵六號海面測高任務驗證
summary: 建立共同時地配對，將偏差、散布與長期漂移分開評估。
summaryEn: Collocate in time and space, then assess bias, scatter and long-term drift separately.

title: OSIRIS-REx 貝努採樣場址取捨
summary: 建立保留安全硬門檻與排序依據的場址取捨表。
summaryEn: Design a site trade with hard safety gates and a separate ranking rationale.

title: GOES-R 氣象地面段與營運概念
titleEn: GOES-R ground segment and concept of operations
summary: 以營運時間線驗證資料從儀器觸發至預報員可用的總延遲。
summaryEn: Use an operational timeline to verify latency from instrument trigger to forecaster availability.

title: 航海家長壽任務的儀器保留策略
titleEn: Instrument retention on long-lived Voyager missions
summary: 用多年資源表比較科學負載保留、休眠與終止時點。
summaryEn: Compare retaining, duty-cycling and retiring science loads in a multiyear resource ledger.

title: Landsat 太陽同步軌道與重訪
subcategoryTitle: 軌道力學與飛行動力學
summary: 從開普勒週期入手，分離單圈週期、地面軌跡重複與地方太陽時。
summaryEn: Start from the Kepler period and distinguish orbital period, ground-track repeat and local solar time.

title: GOES 地球同步定點條件與漂移
subcategoryTitle: 軌道力學與飛行動力學
summary: 推算同步高度並判讀偏離同步半長軸導致的東西漂移。
summaryEn: Derive synchronous altitude and interpret east-west drift from semimajor-axis offsets.

title: INTEGRAL 高偏心軌道與可觀測時段
titleEn: INTEGRAL highly eccentric orbits and observing windows
subcategoryTitle: 軌道力學與飛行動力學
summary: 由近、遠地點估計軌道特徵，再從非等速運動估計可用觀測時段。
summaryEn: Derive orbital elements from perigee and apogee, then estimate observing time under variable orbital speed.

title: 國際太空站交會的相位修正
subcategoryTitle: 軌道力學與飛行動力學
summary: 比較高低軌道的平均運動差，判斷追趕者應如何改變週期。
summaryEn: Compare mean-motion differences at two altitudes to determine how the chaser should adjust its period.

title: 韋伯日地 L₂ 軌道與維持預算
titleEn: Webb Sun–Earth L₂ orbit and maintenance budget
subcategoryTitle: 軌道力學與飛行動力學
summary: 分辨共轉座標的平衡點和附近的三維軌道，建立軌道維持預算。
summaryEn: Distinguish a rotating-frame equilibrium from its nearby three-dimensional orbit and build a station-keeping budget.

title: GRACE-FO 雙星編隊的距離觀測
subcategoryTitle: 軌道力學與飛行動力學
summary: 將絕對距離、微小差分及時戳誤差分開，估計量測時間精度。
summaryEn: Separate absolute separation, tiny differential changes and time-tag errors to estimate timing precision.

title: ICESat-2 重複地面軌跡與冰面變化
titleEn: ICESat-2 repeat ground tracks and ice change
subcategoryTitle: 軌道力學與飛行動力學
summary: 量化軌跡偏移與地表坡度如何在跨期比較中產生假高度變化。
summaryEn: Quantify how track offsets and terrain slopes create apparent height change between repeat passes.

title: 哈伯高度演化與低軌大氣阻力
titleEn: Hubble altitude evolution and low-orbit drag
subcategoryTitle: 軌道力學與飛行動力學
summary: 建立一階阻力及高度衰減估算，將姿態截面和密度列為獨立不確定因子。
summaryEn: Estimate first-order drag and altitude decay, treating projected area and density as separate uncertainty drivers.

title: 卡西尼重力助推與參考系
titleEn: Cassini gravity assist and reference frames
subcategoryTitle: 軌道力學與飛行動力學
summary: 在行星參考系畫速度轉角，再轉回中心天體參考系比較能量。
summaryEn: Plot velocity turning in the flyby body's frame, then compare energy in the central body's frame.

title: 地球到火星的霍曼轉移與發射相位
titleEn: Earth-to-Mars Hohmann transfer and departure phase
subcategoryTitle: 軌道力學與飛行動力學
summary: 以圓形共面行星軌道估計飛行時間與發射時火星應領先的角度。
summaryEn: Estimate flight time and Mars's lead angle at departure for circular coplanar planetary orbits.

title: SLS 火箭推重比與級間切換
summary: 由階段質量與總推力確認初段可離地，並估算上面級的理想 Δv。
summaryEn: Check initial liftoff from phase mass and thrust, then estimate ideal upper-stage Δv.

title: 阿里安六號共乘酬載分離
summary: 以動量守恆求分離後的相對速度與兩端反沖。
summaryEn: Use conservation of momentum to estimate relative release velocity and recoil.

title: 黎明號離子引擎與長時推進
titleEn: Dawn ion propulsion and long burns
summary: 將推力、工作時間、流率和理想 Δv 連到同一推進排程。
summaryEn: Link thrust, operating time, mass flow and ideal Δv in one propulsion schedule.

title: 靈神星任務霍爾推進的功率取捨
titleEn: Psyche Hall propulsion and power trade
summary: 用簡化噴流動能平衡比較功率、效率、推力及比衝。
summaryEn: Compare power, efficiency, thrust and specific impulse through a simplified jet kinetic-energy balance.

title: CAPSTONE 近地注入能量與誤差
titleEn: CAPSTONE near-Earth injection energy and dispersion
summary: 用地心二體近似判別注入後是束縛還是雙曲線，再評估小速度誤差。
summaryEn: Use a geocentric two-body approximation to classify injection energy and assess small speed error.

title: 挑戰者號固體助推器接頭的驗證失效
summary: 在合成試驗資料上建立條件化的證據與停止規則。
summaryEn: Build condition-specific evidence and stopping rules from synthetic tests.

title: 毅力號動力下降與空中吊車
titleEn: Perseverance powered descent and sky crane
summary: 由瞬時質量、火星重力與期望減速反推垂直推力，考慮傾角損失。
summaryEn: Derive vertical thrust from instantaneous mass, Mars gravity and desired deceleration, allowing for tilt losses.

title: MarCO 冷氣推進的角衝量
summary: 從成對推進器配置估算角衝量，檢查耦合平移與姿態速率。
summaryEn: Estimate angular impulse from a thruster pair and check coupled translation and body rate.

title: 獵戶座服務艙推進劑與保留量
summary: 用火箭方程建立單次燃燒、保留量與敏感度，分開核對不可用餘量。
summaryEn: Use the rocket equation to budget a burn, reserve and sensitivity while separating unusable residuals.

title: ATV 為太空站補升軌道
titleEn: ATV reboost of the International Space Station
summary: 由推力時長求切向 Δv，再估算近圓軌道半長軸變化。
summaryEn: Derive tangential Δv from the burn and estimate the semimajor-axis change for a nearly circular orbit.

title: 韋伯分段主鏡的熱縮與界面
titleEn: Webb segmented mirror contraction and interfaces
summary: 以平均熱膨脹係數比較兩材料冷卻位移，提出消除過拘束的支撐方案。
summaryEn: Compare cooling displacement using average coefficients of thermal expansion and propose a mount that avoids overconstraint.

title: ISS 微流星與碎片防護夾層
summary: 比較面密度、間距與防護約束，辨識面密度對性能的解釋邊界。
summaryEn: Compare areal density, spacing and shielding constraints and identify the limits of areal-density reasoning.

title: 獵戶座 Avcoat 熱防護與炭化
titleEn: Orion Avcoat thermal protection and char behavior
summary: 從熱通量歷程估計面熱載荷，再區分傳熱、炭化與材料剝落。
summaryEn: Estimate surface heat load from a flux history and distinguish heat transfer, charring and material loss.

title: 露西號太陽翼展開力矩與鎖定
titleEn: Lucy solar-array deployment torque and latching
summary: 建立展開力矩平衡，將位置、電流與鎖扣狀態分別判讀。
summaryEn: Build a deployment torque balance and interpret position, current and latch state separately.

title: 韋伯發射環境的振動譜與模態
titleEn: Webb launch environment, vibration spectra and modes
summary: 從功率譜密度積分得到基座加速度，再比較結構共振響應。
summaryEn: Integrate acceleration power spectral density for base excitation, then compare structural resonance.

title: 機智號輕量旋翼的尖端速率
summary: 從轉速與半徑推算尖端馬赫數，追蹤前進側與低溫音速的影響。
summaryEn: Derive tip Mach number from RPM and radius, including advancing-side speed and cold sound speed.

title: 光學太空器低逸氣材料篩選
summary: 由見證基板與試片重量推算質量損失與可凝結物，建立材料篩選表。
summaryEn: Derive mass loss and condensable mass from specimens and witness collectors and build a screening table.

title: 阿波羅登月艙著陸架能量吸收
titleEn: Apollo lunar module landing-gear energy absorption
summary: 估計下降動能、壓潰行程及平均總支撐力，檢查四腳分載。
summaryEn: Estimate descent energy, crush stroke and average total reaction, then inspect load sharing across four legs.

title: 哈伯太陽翼熱變形與指向抖動
titleEn: Hubble solar-array thermal distortion and pointing jitter
summary: 估算熱伸縮尺度並建立從翼梁擾動到指向的測試。
summaryEn: Estimate thermal expansion scale and design a test from boom disturbance to pointing response.

title: 小衛星質心、配重與構型管理
titleEn: SmallSat center of gravity, ballast and configuration control
summary: 建立一維質心計算與變更監測，準備對應台架量測。
summaryEn: Build a one-axis center-of-gravity ledger and change monitoring with corresponding bench measurements.

title: 帕克太陽探測器液冷熱量平衡
subcategoryTitleEn: Spacecraft thermal control, power, and energy storage
summary: 估計液冷流率並以溫差、熱輸入與泵狀態交叉診斷。
summaryEn: Estimate cooling flow and diagnose using temperature rise, heat input and pump state.

title: MIRI 低溫冷卻器的功耗界限
subcategoryTitleEn: Spacecraft thermal control, power, and energy storage
summary: 由可逆效率上限反推移除極低溫負載的最低功率，再與實用效率比較。
summaryEn: Derive minimum work to remove a very cold heat load and compare with a practical efficiency scenario.

title: 太空站地影放電與循環容量
titleEn: ISS eclipse discharge and cycling capacity
subcategoryTitleEn: Spacecraft thermal control, power, and energy storage
summary: 按地影時長、效率與容許放電深度推導最低教學名目容量。
summaryEn: Size minimum nominal teaching capacity from eclipse duration, efficiency and allowable depth of discharge.

title: 毅力號同位素電源與火星日預算
titleEn: Perseverance radioisotope power and sol budget

summaryEn: Using NEWater as the reference, the learner acts as a water-quality engineer following water and contaminants through feed, membrane trains, disinfection, storage and demand.

title: 新加坡深隧道污水系統
summary: 以DTSS觀察集中污水系統，先分清幹管輸送與末端處理，再檢查尖峰、沉積、提升與備援的耦合。
summaryEn: Use DTSS to examine centralized sewerage, distinguishing conveyance from treatment before checking peaks, sediment, lifting and redundancy.

title: 加州地下水補注系統 GWRS
summary: GWRS將膜處理與UV/H₂O₂後的水送至補注系統。本課追蹤水質障壁、補注能力與地下水傳輸，避免把地下水視為無限儲槽。
summaryEn: GWRS sends membrane- and UV/H₂O₂-treated water to recharge systems. This lesson follows barriers, recharge capacity and aquifer transport without assuming unlimited groundwater …

title: 倫敦泰晤士潮汐隧道
summary: 從溢流口走到豎井、隧道與後端處理，學習為何截流、調蓄和抽送必須同時檢查；隧道本身不是污水淨化反應器。
summaryEn: Follow overflow interception through shafts, tunnel and downstream treatment, checking capture, storage and pumping together; the tunnel is not itself a purification reactor.

title: 芝加哥深隧道與水庫計畫
summary: TARP展示如何把暴雨期間的混合水暫存，於能力允許時送回處理。學徒需建立前一場雨尚未排空的連續事件情境。
summaryEn: TARP illustrates storing combined flows during storms and returning them for treatment when capacity permits. The learner must model consecutive events before storage has emptied.

title: 維也納污水處理能源自給計畫
summary: 以維也納E_OS為案例，將水線需氧與污泥產氣放在同一能量帳；先看出水要求，再比較有機物進曝氣或消化的不同去向。
summaryEn: Using Vienna E_OS, put liquid-line oxygen demand and sludge gas recovery in one energy ledger; meet effluent needs before comparing carbon sent to aeration or digestion.

title: 哥本哈根阿邁厄巴克焚化發電廠
summary: 把Amager Bakke拆成進料、燃燒、蒸汽、熱電、煙氣及灰渣六條證據鏈；公共空間外觀與工廠環境績效分開驗證。
summaryEn: Divide Amager Bakke into evidence chains for feed, combustion, steam, energy, flue gas and ash; assess public-space appearance separately from environmental performance.

title: 東京有明水再生中心
summary: 有明的公開流程具有厭氧、無氧、好氧與生物膜過濾，部分出水另作回用。課程讓學徒區分水質處理鏈與再生水用途鏈。
summaryEn: Ariake documents anaerobic, anoxic, aerobic and biofilm-filter processes, with a portion further treated for reuse. The learner separates treatment and end-use chains.

summary: 以乘客和熱工程師角色比較冷暖需求，明列除濕、除霜與附件用電。
summaryEn: Compare heating/cooling needs as passenger and thermal engineer, including dehumidification, defrost and auxiliary electricity.

title: 輪胎結構與製造品質
summary: 從材料與硫化到均勻性和滾阻，將充氣條件、接地壓力與耐久試驗分開。
summaryEn: Move from materials/cure to uniformity and rolling resistance, separating inflation, contact pressure and durability.

title: 汽車座椅人體工學
summary: 由乘員姿態到機械支撐與調整路徑，保留體型差異及局部峰壓。
summaryEn: Follow posture through mechanical support and adjustment, retaining anthropometric differences and local pressure peaks.

title: 汽車玻璃夾層製程
summary: 從層間材料到貼合與光學觀察，分開導熱、黏結和視覺失真。
summaryEn: Move from interlayer materials to lamination and optical observation, separating conduction, bonding and distortion.

title: 活塞引擎曲軸製造
summary: 以製造與耐久角色串接毛坯、加工、表面、平衡與疲勞證據。
summaryEn: Connect blank, machining, surface condition, balancing and fatigue from manufacturing/durability viewpoints.

title: 引擎汽缸頭冷卻設計
summary: 從鑄造水道到熱流與局部溫度，檢查幾何堵塞、氣穴與熱疲勞。
summaryEn: Follow cast passages through heat flow and local temperature, checking geometric blockage, vapor pockets and thermal fatigue.

title: 汽車渦輪增壓器工程
summary: 以氣路與轉子兩條故事線連結壓力比、熱量、平衡及工作點邊界。
summaryEn: Join gas-path and rotor storylines through pressure ratio, heat, balance and map boundaries.

title: 汽車雙離合器變速箱
summary: 從機構與控制角色檢查扭矩接替、滑差熱及保護，避免把接合時間單獨當舒適指標。
summaryEn: Check torque handoff, slip heat and protection as mechanism/controls engineers without treating engagement time alone as comfort.

title: 混合動力行星齒輪機構
summary: 用三端速度約束與能量平衡走過混合動力模式，不假設所有品牌同一拓撲。
summaryEn: Explore hybrid modes using three-member kinematics and energy balance without assuming one topology across brands.

title: 商用車空氣煞車概念
summary: 在無壓示意與合成資料中追蹤供氣、控制和摩擦制動，不提供真車調整設定。
summaryEn: Trace supply, control and friction braking in unpressurized schematics and synthetic data without vehicle adjustment settings.

title: 軌道車輛轉向架組裝
summary: 從裝配基準走到輪重和振動檢查，追蹤每條載荷路徑的接頭。
summaryEn: Move from assembly datums to wheel loads and vibration, tracing joints along every load path.

title: 軌道輪對製造與檢驗
summary: 以鍛造、加工與檢測角色檢查尺寸、過盈和表面缺陷，保留不可達區。
summaryEn: Inspect dimensions, interference and surface flaws from forging/machining/inspection viewpoints, retaining inaccessible regions.

title: 軌道車輛牽引逆變器
summary: 沿電網到輪端的功率路徑檢查逆變、損失及熱管理，用假想數值保持單位一致。
summaryEn: Trace grid-to-wheel power through inversion, losses and cooling with consistent synthetic units.

title: 列車受電弓接觸工程
summary: 由機械支承到電氣接觸，分開平均接觸力、瞬時離線和熱效應。
summaryEn: Move from support mechanics to electrical contact, separating mean force, momentary separation and heating.

title: 列車通訊網路
summary: 從車廂加入到訊息時序與隔離故障，將路由可達與功能允許分開。
summaryEn: Follow car joining through message timing and fault isolation, separating network reachability from functional permission.

title: 捷運車門與月臺門協同
summary: 以乘客、車輛與月臺控制三個視角核對狀態機，不以單一計時器授予出發許可。
summaryEn: Check state machines from passenger, vehicle and platform viewpoints rather than granting departure from a timer alone.

title: 軌道車輛空氣彈簧
summary: 從載重變化到氣室和高度調整，用明確的絕對壓力與有效體積分析。
summaryEn: Follow load changes through chambers and leveling using explicit absolute pressure and effective volume.

title: 列車制動熱負載管理
summary: 以能量分配與耐久兩條路徑檢查長坡或連續停站的熱負荷，保留冷卻間隔。
summaryEn: Use energy-sharing and durability paths to examine sustained-grade or repeated-stop heat loads, retaining cooling intervals.

title: 蒸汽機車鍋爐保存檢驗概念
summary: 僅以保存檔案及無壓數位模型學習缺陷分類，將操作許可留給合格專業評定。
summaryEn: Study defect classification only through preservation records and unpressurized digital models; operating authorization requires qualified assessment.

title: 蒸汽機車連桿與配氣機構
summary: 在無動力機構示意追蹤位置、相位及連接負荷，區分幾何關係與實際蒸汽動力。
summaryEn: Trace position, phase and joint load in an unpowered schematic, separating kinematics from real steam power.

title: 軌道車輛整車耐久試驗
summary: 以試驗規劃者角色建立載荷譜、感測及停檢證據，避免把加速次數等同實際使用年限。
summaryEn: Build load spectra, sensing and inspection evidence as a test planner without equating accelerated cycles to service years.

title: Sputnik 1 衛星工程史
summary: 從三站接收時刻推斷過境次序，分離軌道證據與無線電振盪器漂移。
summaryEn: Infer pass order from three receiving stations and separate orbital evidence from oscillator drift.

title: Explorer 1 科學衛星
summary: 建立計數器死時間模型，避免把高通量下的計數不足誤認為沒有粒子。
summaryEn: Model detector dead time so undercounting at high flux is not mistaken for an absence of particles.

title: Vanguard 衛星計畫
summary: 建立分日照與地影的能量帳，求電池容量及充電餘裕。
summaryEn: Build a sunlight/eclipsed energy ledger and determine battery capacity and charging margin.

title: TIROS 氣象衛星計畫
summary: 量化雲圖取樣與地面移動造成的像元拖影，規劃可辨識雲界的教學影像。
summaryEn: Quantify sampling and motion smear to plan an image that resolves a cloud boundary.

title: Telstar 通訊衛星
summary: 在共同可見時窗內排定資料轉送，區分接觸時間、有效酬載與傳播延遲。
summaryEn: Schedule relay inside a common visibility window while separating contact time, useful payload and propagation delay.

title: Syncom 同步通訊衛星
summary: 求同步圓軌道半徑，辨識同步與固定於地面視線的額外條件。
summaryEn: Calculate synchronous circular-orbit radius and identify additional conditions for a fixed ground direction.

title: Landsat 地球觀測計畫
summary: 建立兩時期地表分類的面積帳與誤差矩陣，避免把雲影或配準錯誤當土地變遷。
summaryEn: Build a two-date land-cover area ledger and confusion matrix so cloud shadows and misregistration are not treated as change.

title: GOES 氣象觀測衛星
summary: 用影像時間序列估計雲頂降溫率，辨識時間戳錯位與雲體追蹤錯配。
summaryEn: Estimate cloud-top cooling rate and detect timestamp errors or mismatched cloud tracking.

title: Meteosat 氣象衛星
summary: 用連續雲圖做平面風場教學估計，量化時間間距與影像配準對速度的影響。
summaryEn: Estimate planar cloud motion and quantify the effect of frame spacing and registration on velocity.

title: Sentinel-1 雷達地球觀測
summary: 從合成干涉相位求視線位移，辨識相位包裹、低相干及大氣混淆。
summaryEn: Infer line-of-sight displacement from synthetic interferometric phase and distinguish wrapping, low coherence and atmospheric ambiguity.

title: Sentinel-2 多光譜觀測
summary: 將不同像元大小的波段配準至共同網格，保留反射率平均與品質遮罩。
summaryEn: Register bands of different pixel sizes to a shared grid while preserving reflectance averages and quality masks.

title: Sentinel-3 海陸環境觀測
summary: 以簡化雙通道模型估算海表溫度，追蹤大氣修正與共同校準偏差。
summaryEn: Estimate sea-surface temperature with a simplified two-channel model and track atmospheric correction and common calibration bias.

title: Terra 地球科學衛星
summary: 建立頂層大氣短波與長波收支，檢查符號及空間時間平均的適用性。
summaryEn: Construct a top-of-atmosphere shortwave/longwave balance and check signs and averaging assumptions.

title: Aqua 水循環觀測衛星
summary: 將蒸發、降雨及水氣儲存變化組成區域水量帳，推定水平輸送的殘差。
summaryEn: Combine evaporation, precipitation and vapour storage change into a regional water ledger and infer transport as a residual.

title: Aura 大氣化學衛星
summary: 由離散高度層估算微量氣體柱濃度，區分體積濃度、混合比及柱量。
summaryEn: Estimate trace-gas column abundance from vertical layers while distinguishing number density, mixing ratio and column amount.

title: Suomi NPP 氣象環境衛星
titleEn: Suomi NPP weather and environment satellite
summary: 建立夜間低光影像的背景扣除與跨景比較，避免月光和雲誤當人造照明改變。
summaryEn: Build background-subtracted low-light comparisons without confusing moonlight or cloud with changing artificial illumination.

title: GPM 全球降水觀測
summary: 由不等時段降雨率積分累積雨量，處理缺測而不把缺測當零雨。
summaryEn: Integrate rainfall rates over unequal intervals and handle missing observations without assuming no rain.

title: SMAP 土壤水分衛星
summary: 用合成校準線反演體積含水量，量化亮溫誤差與不適用地表的影響。
summaryEn: Invert a synthetic calibration line for volumetric moisture and quantify brightness-temperature error and invalid surfaces.

title: GRACE 地球重力測量
summary: 把區域等效水厚變化換成質量，說明地下水推論還需要其他儲水成分。
summaryEn: Convert regional equivalent-water-thickness change to mass and identify additional storage components needed to infer groundwater.

title: ICESat-2 雷射測高衛星
summary: 在重複軌跡分析中扣除橫向偏移遇到地表坡度造成的假高度變化。
summaryEn: Remove apparent elevation change caused by cross-track displacement over sloping terrain in repeat-track analysis.

title: SWOT 地表水與海洋衛星
summary: 用合成湖面面積與高度變化估計蓄水增量，驗證固定面積近似。
summaryEn: Estimate a synthetic lake-storage change from area and elevation and test the constant-area approximation.

title: PACE 海洋與大氣觀測
summary: 用合成藍綠波段比值研究海色特徵，分離大氣殘差與水體訊號。
summaryEn: Use a synthetic blue/green ratio to study ocean-colour features while separating atmospheric residuals from water signals.

title: OCO-2 二氧化碳觀測
summary: 計算乾空氣柱平均混合比，解釋乾空氣正規化與空間代表性。
summaryEn: Calculate dry-air column-averaged mixing ratio and explain dry-air normalization and spatial representativeness.

title: Hubble 太空望遠鏡
summary: 估算繞射角尺度與感測器取樣，分離光學解析力、像元尺度及指向模糊。
summaryEn: Estimate diffraction scale and detector sampling while separating optical resolution, pixel scale and pointing blur.

title: James Webb 太空望遠鏡
summary: 計算譜線紅移與解析需求，區分單線猜測與多線一致識別。
summaryEn: Calculate line redshift and resolution requirements,distinguishing a single-line guess from consistent multi-line identification.

title: Chandra X 射線天文台
summary: 在源區與背景區分離計數，傳播泊松誤差並檢查背景面積比例。
summaryEn: Separate source and background counts,propagate Poisson error and verify background-area scaling.

title: Spitzer 紅外線望遠鏡
summary: 用黑體近似比較溫度與輻射峰位置，建立紅外線背景的量級直覺。
summaryEn: Use a blackbody approximation to compare temperature and emission peak,building intuition for infrared background.

title: Kepler 系外行星望遠鏡
summary: 由凌日深度估算半徑比，檢查恆星參數、邊緣昏暗及混光限制。
summaryEn: Estimate radius ratio from transit depth and examine stellar,limb-darkening and dilution limitations.

title: TESS 系外行星巡天
summary: 計算鄰星混光對凌日深度的稀釋，規劃質心與孔徑比較驗證。
summaryEn: Calculate transit-depth dilution from a neighbouring star and plan centroid/aperture checks.

title: Gaia 天體測量衛星
summary: 從高訊噪比合成視差估距，評估零點偏差並辨識低訊噪比反演限制。
summaryEn: Infer distance from a high-SNR synthetic parallax,assess zero-point bias and identify low-SNR inversion limits.

title: Euclid 宇宙學望遠鏡
summary: 在弱透鏡教學模型中去除點擴散函數的形狀偏差，評估平均形狀的系統誤差。
summaryEn: Remove PSF shape bias in a teaching weak-lensing model and assess systematic error in mean galaxy shape.

title: Planck 宇宙微波觀測
summary: 合併兩個有不同噪聲的天空估值，檢查逆變異數加權及共同前景偏差。
summaryEn: Combine sky estimates with unequal noise using inverse-variance weights and test common foreground bias.

title: COBE 宇宙背景探測
summary: 用教學差分輻射計模型求溫度差，評估增益與偏置校準。
summaryEn: Infer temperature differences from a teaching differential-radiometer model and assess gain/offset calibration.

title: WMAP 微波異向性探測
summary: 由差分觀測重建小型天空圖，辨識不可觀測的共同常數與閉合殘差。
summaryEn: Reconstruct a small sky map from differences and identify the unobservable common offset and closure residual.

title: Fermi 伽瑪射線望遠鏡
summary: 以有效面積和活時間估算光子通量，區分事件數、計數率及曝光。
summaryEn: Estimate photon flux from effective area and live time,distinguishing counts,count rate and exposure.

title: XMM-Newton X 射線天文台
summary: 從高背景時段剔除不適用資料，計算好時間區間與有效計數率。
summaryEn: Remove unsuitable high-background intervals and calculate good-time exposure and count rate.

title: NuSTAR 高能 X 射線望遠鏡
summary: 用長焦距光學教學模型換算結構橫向位移成角誤差，規劃熱變形量測。
summaryEn: Convert lateral structural displacement into angular error in a long-focus teaching model and plan thermal-deformation metrology.

title: IXPE X 射線偏振探測
summary: 由合成 Stokes 參數估算偏振比例，辨識正值偏差及儀器調變校準。
summaryEn: Estimate polarization fraction from synthetic Stokes parameters and recognize positive bias and modulation calibration.

title: SOHO 太陽觀測衛星
summary: 從合成日冕影像估算平面投影速度，辨識三維幾何與到達時間推論限制。
summaryEn: Estimate plane-of-sky speed from synthetic coronagraph images and identify limits on 3D geometry and arrival inference.

title: Parker Solar Probe 太陽探測
summary: 以距離平方反比估算入射熱通量，區分表面吸收、反射及實際溫度。
summaryEn: Estimate incident flux by inverse-square distance and separate absorption,reflection and actual temperature.

title: Solar Orbiter 太陽軌道探測
summary: 建立遠端影像與原位粒子量測的時間配對，量化傳播速度假設。
summaryEn: Pair remote images with in-situ particle measurements and quantify propagation-speed assumptions.

title: SDO 太陽動力觀測
summary: 設計太陽振盪的時間取樣，檢查奈奎斯特條件、曝光平均與缺幀。
summaryEn: Design temporal sampling for solar oscillations and test Nyquist limits,exposure averaging and missing frames.

title: Voyager 星際探測計畫
summary: 建立長通訊延遲下的指令、執行與確認時間軸，避免重複指令。
summaryEn: Build command,execution and acknowledgment timelines under long light-time delay and prevent duplicate commands.

title: Pioneer 深空探測計畫
summary: 估算非對稱熱輻射的反衝加速度，檢查微小系統力如何累積成追蹤殘差。
summaryEn: Estimate recoil acceleration from asymmetric thermal radiation and examine accumulation of small systematic forces.

title: Cassini-Huygens 土星探測
summary: 設計探測資料收集、緩衝與中繼的時序帳，檢查輸入輸出速率不匹配。
summaryEn: Design a probe-data acquisition,buffer and relay ledger and test mismatched input/output rates.

title: Galileo 木星探測
summary: 在低資料率模型中估算影像回傳時間，區分壓縮比、資料品質與通訊效率。
summaryEn: Estimate image downlink time in a low-rate model while distinguishing compression,quality and link efficiency.

title: Juno 木星探測
summary: 建立分階段累積輻射劑量帳，區分瞬時劑量率、累積劑量與元件驗證。
summaryEn: Build a phase-by-phase radiation-dose ledger and distinguish dose rate,cumulative dose and component qualification.

title: New Horizons 冥王星探測
summary: 以直線飛越幾何估算目標距離門檻內的可觀測時間，安排互斥儀器任務。
summaryEn: Estimate time inside a target-distance limit using straight-line flyby geometry and schedule mutually exclusive instrument tasks.

title: MESSENGER 水星探測
summary: 在合成行星影像中校正入射角影響，避免把照明差異當材質差異。
summaryEn: Correct illumination-angle effects in synthetic planetary imagery so lighting is not mistaken for composition.

title: BepiColombo 水星探測
summary: 建立雙太空器時間同步的教學模型，區分時鐘偏差與真正傳播相位。
summaryEn: Build a two-spacecraft timing model and distinguish clock offset from true propagation phase.

title: Magellan 金星雷達探測
summary: 分開斜距解析度、地距解析度與地形造成的幾何畸變。
summaryEn: Separate slant-range resolution, ground-range resolution and terrain-induced distortion.

title: Venus Express 金星大氣探測
summary: 以可追溯的兩時刻雲圖估計表觀雲移速率，辨認配準誤差。
summaryEn: Estimate apparent cloud drift from two traceable images and distinguish registration error.

title: Viking 火星登陸計畫
summary: 用對照扣除與不確定度傳播說明「有訊號」和「有生命」是不同命題。
summaryEn: Use control subtraction and uncertainty propagation to distinguish a signal from evidence of life.

title: Mars Pathfinder 火星探路者
summary: 在輪速與影像位移之間建立滑移估計，不把馬達轉動當作實際行進。
summaryEn: Estimate slip from wheel motion and image displacement instead of equating motor rotation with travel.

title: Mars Exploration Rovers 火星車
summary: 建立含固定生存負載與可延期科學活動的單日能量排程。
summaryEn: Build a daily energy schedule separating survival loads from deferrable science.

title: Curiosity 火星科學實驗室
summary: 以混樣質量平衡辨認真實成分與前一個樣品殘留。
summaryEn: Use mixture mass balance to distinguish composition from carryover of a preceding sample.

title: Perseverance 火星探測車
summary: 用獨立且可檢查的失聯假設評估一組樣管脈絡保存機率。
summaryEn: Evaluate the probability of retaining sample context under explicit, testable loss assumptions.

title: Ingenuity 火星直升機
summary: 以理想致動盤模型估算懸停誘導功率，識別實機功耗中被忽略的項目。
summaryEn: Estimate hover induced power with an ideal actuator disk and identify omitted real power demands.

title: InSight 火星地球物理站
summary: 以 S−P 到時差估算簡化距離，分辨單一事件定位與速度模型假設。
summaryEn: Estimate a simplified distance from S−P arrival time while distinguishing event location from velocity-model assumptions.

title: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter
summary: 由地面移動速度與曝光時間估算拖影，與像素尺度分開評估。
summaryEn: Estimate motion smear from ground speed and exposure, separately from pixel scale.

title: MAVEN 火星大氣探測
summary: 從兩高度密度估算局部尺度高度，辨認非靜力條件。
summaryEn: Estimate local scale height from densities at two altitudes and identify nonhydrostatic conditions.

title: Mars Express 火星探測
summary: 把雙程雷達延遲換算成介質厚度，明確保留介電常數歧義。
summaryEn: Convert two-way radar delay into layer thickness while retaining dielectric ambiguity.

title: Rosetta 彗星探測
summary: 用球對稱重力估算速度尺度，指出不能直接拿來設計真實近彗星軌道。
summaryEn: Estimate a velocity scale with spherical gravity and explain why it cannot directly design a real near-comet orbit.

title: Hayabusa 小行星採樣
summary: 由光學位置不確定度與接近速度估計一次接近的觀測更新需求。
summaryEn: Estimate observation-update requirements from optical position uncertainty and approach speed.

title: Hayabusa2 小行星採樣
summary: 評估小樣品質量分配對代表性與保留量的影響。
summaryEn: Evaluate how small-sample allocation affects representativeness and retained material.

title: OSIRIS-REx 小行星採樣
summary: 利用全程空白量化低濃度分析中的污染上限。
summaryEn: Quantify an upper contamination bound using process blanks in trace analysis.

summary: 由目標槽寬反推電極尺寸，理解放電間隙補償。
summaryEn: Infer electrode width from target cavity width and understand spark-gap compensation.

title: 線切割放電加工
summary: 從線徑與間隙計算切縫及最小內角半徑，檢查圖面可製造性。
summaryEn: Compute kerf and minimum internal radius from wire diameter and gap to check manufacturability.

title: 電化學精密加工
summary: 以法拉第定律建立電荷與移除質量的量綱關係，只作離線材料帳。
summaryEn: Use Faraday’s law to relate charge and removed mass in an offline material balance.

title: 工業雷射焊接
summary: 用自由熱收縮量建立焊接變形的尺度概念，分清收縮與拘束應力。
summaryEn: Use free thermal contraction to establish distortion scale and distinguish shrinkage from restraint stress.

title: 摩擦攪拌接合
summary: 用扭矩與轉角估計機械功，區分能量帳與接合品質。
summaryEn: Estimate mechanical work from torque and angle, distinguishing energy accounting from weld quality.

title: 電子束材料接合概念
summary: 以理想抽氣模型研究腔體時間成本與漏氣底限，全程離線。
summaryEn: Study chamber cycle time and leak floor with an ideal offline pumpdown model.

stages.title: 案例界面與資料可信度

title: 金屬粉床熔融製程
summary: 由合成收縮率反算 CAD 補償尺寸，再確認單一縮放是否足以解釋各方向誤差。
summaryEn: Infer CAD compensation from synthetic shrinkage and test whether one scale explains all directions.

stages.title: 案例界面與資料可信度
建立物理模型與單位帳

title: 定向能量沉積修復
summary: 建立掃描缺損、補料體積與精加工餘量的一致基準，分清成形外觀與冶金結合證據。
summaryEn: Reconcile scan loss, deposited volume and machining allowance without confusing shape recovery with metallurgical bonding.

title: 金屬黏結劑噴印
summary: 以三方向量測判斷單一縮放因子是否足夠，建立生胚到燒結件尺寸鏈。
summaryEn: Determine whether one scale factor suffices from three-direction measurements and build a green-to-sintered dimension chain.

title: 立體光固化成形
summary: 用明確的高度與層厚估計層數，將可見階梯、支撐痕與尺寸誤差分開驗收。
summaryEn: Estimate layer count from height and thickness, with separate criteria for stair steps, support scars and dimensional error.

title: 工業粉末燒結
summary: 在質量守恆前提下連接相對密度與體積，並指出脫脂期間不能直接套用同一質量。
summaryEn: Connect relative density and volume under mass conservation, identifying why debinding violates an unchanged-mass assumption.

title: 熱等靜壓緻密化
summary: 辨認密度提升、內部缺陷閉合與表面連通孔之間的證據差異。
summaryEn: Distinguish evidence for bulk density, internal defect closure and surface-connected pores.

title: 金屬射出成形
summary: 把金屬質量分率與體積分率分清，從配料帳推算燒結成品的理想體積。
summaryEn: Separate metal mass fraction from volume fraction and infer ideal sintered volume from the feedstock ledger.

title: 精密脫蠟鑄造
summary: 將模具、蠟模、鑄件與成品四層尺寸追溯，避免把不同階段收縮直接相加。
summaryEn: Trace tooling, wax pattern, casting and finished dimensions without adding shrinkages from different reference stages.

title: 大型砂模鑄造
summary: 從外模、砂心與基準偏移推算最薄壁，建立可辨認偏心與整體縮放的量測計畫。
summaryEn: Infer minimum wall from mold, core and datum offset, distinguishing eccentricity from global scale error.

title: 高壓壓鑄模具工程
summary: 辨認模腔壓力作用的投影面積與總表面積差異，建立鎖模力概念預算。
summaryEn: Distinguish pressure-projected area from total surface area and build a conceptual clamping-force budget.

title: 閉模鍛造成形
summary: 從成品、加工餘量與飛邊建立毛坯體積帳，並分清材料利用率和鍛造品質。
summaryEn: Build a billet-volume ledger from finished shape, allowance and flash, separating material utilization from forging quality.

title: 板材深引伸製程
summary: 由杯底與側壁面積估胚料直徑，辨認忽略圓角與厚度變化的限制。
summaryEn: Estimate blank diameter from cup-bottom and wall areas, retaining corner-radius and thickness limitations.

title: 金屬旋壓成形
summary: 正確定義錐半角與厚度法向，不將剪旋壓正弦律套用全部旋壓。
summaryEn: Define cone half-angle and normal thickness, without applying the shear-spinning sine law to every spinning process.

title: 管件液壓成形
summary: 由自由體圖推導環向應力，辨認圓管薄壁模型何時不能代表成形圓角。
summaryEn: Derive hoop stress and identify why a thin circular-tube model cannot represent all forming corners.

title: 粉末冶金齒輪製造
summary: 以環形近似核對齒輪坯重量，將齒根局部孔隙與整體密度分開驗收。
summaryEn: Check blank mass with an annular approximation and assess local tooth-root porosity separately from bulk density.

title: 齒輪滾齒與剃齒
summary: 把模數、齒數與節圓關係算清，區分滾齒生成幾何與剃齒修整。
summaryEn: Calculate module, tooth count and pitch diameter, distinguishing generated geometry from shaving refinement.

title: 齒輪滲碳熱處理
summary: 以平方根時間律做相對比較，將有效硬化層深度、碳濃度與硬度定義分開。
summaryEn: Use square-root time scaling for relative comparisons, distinguishing effective case depth, carbon concentration and hardness definitions.

title: 精密滾動軸承製造
summary: 正確把百萬轉換成小時，說明 L10 是群體統計額定值而非個別保證。
summaryEn: Convert million revolutions to hours and explain L10 as a population rating rather than an individual guarantee.

title: 機械密封設計與檢驗
summary: 區分密封面線速度、摩擦功率及整台泵損耗，建立熱量去向圖。
summaryEn: Distinguish seal-face sliding speed, friction power and whole-pump loss, mapping heat destinations.

title: 工業泵浦效率測試
summary: 建立流量、揚程、軸功率與電力的量測邊界，避免算出超過100%的假效率。
summaryEn: Define flow, head, shaft and electrical measurement boundaries to prevent spurious efficiencies above 100%.

title: 工業壓縮機系統整合
summary: 在相同參考空氣條件下把洩漏流量轉成耗能，分開平均比能耗與瞬時功率。
summaryEn: Convert leakage into energy on common reference-air conditions, distinguishing average specific energy from instantaneous power.

title: 高速轉子動平衡
summary: 區分不平衡量g·mm與振動幅度，說明校正質量位置和相位的重要性。
summaryEn: Distinguish unbalance in g·mm from vibration amplitude and explain correction radius and phase.

title: 工業減速機裝配
summary: 逐級追蹤減速比與效率，避免把減速當成能量增加。
summaryEn: Track ratio and efficiency stage by stage without treating reduction as an energy gain.

title: 工業機器人運動學
summary: 從關節相對角推導末端位置，辨認第二連桿使用累積角而非單獨角。
summaryEn: Derive endpoint position from relative joint angles, using the accumulated second-link angle.

title: 機器人工作空間規劃
summary: 辨認可達點、可達姿態與無碰撞路徑三種不同問題。
summaryEn: Distinguish reachable points, reachable poses and collision-free paths.

title: 機器人路徑平滑
summary: 由位置函數求導，檢查起終速度為零以及縮短時間造成的加速度代價。
summaryEn: Differentiate position, check zero endpoint velocities and quantify acceleration costs of shorter duration.

title: 機器人手眼校準
summary: 用小型坐標例子驗證變換乘法順序，並以保留姿態評估校準。
summaryEn: Verify transform order with a small coordinate example and assess calibration on held-out poses.

title: 機器人力控裝配
summary: 區分接觸剛性、力感測偏置與位置誤差，設計能辨識成因的離線試驗。
summaryEn: Distinguish contact stiffness, sensor bias and position error with an identifiable offline experiment.

title: 機器人末端夾具設計
summary: 畫出兩接觸點受力，明確區分每爪法向力與總夾持力。
summaryEn: Draw both contacts and distinguish per-jaw normal force from total gripping force.

title: 柔性夾爪與軟體機器人
summary: 比較幾何尺寸對柔順度的影響，辨認小變形梁與大變形軟體機器人的差距。
summaryEn: Compare geometric effects on compliance and distinguish small-deflection beams from large-deformation soft robots.

title: 真空吸附搬運工站
summary: 區分絕對壓力與壓差、理論保持力與可用負載，建立失壓情境。
summaryEn: Distinguish absolute pressure from differential pressure and theoretical force from allowable load.

title: 機器視覺尺寸檢測
summary: 把邊緣定位誤差與比例校準誤差分開，避免把像素解析度直接當量測準確度。
summaryEn: Separate edge-location error from scale-calibration uncertainty instead of equating pixel resolution with accuracy.

title: 三維視覺散料揀選
summary: 由視差推深度並評估遠距誤差放大，把可見點與可抓取姿態分開。
summaryEn: Infer depth from disparity and assess distant-error amplification, distinguishing visible points from graspable poses.

title: 工業機器人安全工作站
summary: 把感測延遲、處理延遲與停止距離分開，不把簡化課內距離視為合規防護距離。
summaryEn: Separate sensing/processing delay and stopping distance without treating the classroom sum as a compliant safeguard distance.

title: 協作機器人應用驗證
summary: 區分等效質量、速度、接觸力及壓力，建立完整應用驗證的缺口表。
summaryEn: Distinguish effective mass, speed, contact force and pressure, building an application-validation gap list.

title: 移動機器人定位與建圖
summary: 理解獨立無偏量測的加權融合，並找出共享偏差使過度自信的情境。
summaryEn: Understand weighted fusion of independent unbiased measurements and detect overconfidence from shared bias.

title: 倉儲機器人車隊管理
summary: 將到達率、服務時間與利用率分開，辨認增加機器人不必然消除工作站瓶頸。
summaryEn: Separate arrival rate, service time and utilization, and recognize that more robots need not remove port bottlenecks.

title: 自動化立體倉庫
summary: 區分平行運動的最大值與串聯時間加總，建立儲取事件時序。
summaryEn: Distinguish the maximum of parallel motions from summed sequential times, building a retrieval timeline.

title: 工廠輸送線節拍平衡
summary: 區分客戶需求節拍與各站週期，找出平均時間會掩蓋的瓶頸。
summaryEn: Distinguish demand takt from station cycle time and expose bottlenecks hidden by averages.

title: 自動化光學檢查產線
summary: 由混淆矩陣同時計算漏檢與誤剔，避免用高準確率掩蓋少數瑕疵。
summaryEn: Calculate missed defects and false rejects from a confusion matrix instead of hiding rare defects behind high accuracy.

title: 工廠統計製程管制
summary: 分開評估散布與偏心，明確規格界限不等於統計管制界限。
summaryEn: Assess spread and centering separately, distinguishing specification from statistical control limits.

title: 量測系統分析 GRR
summary: 正確合成標準差，區分量測變異占總變異與占公差寬度兩種指標。
summaryEn: Combine standard deviations correctly and distinguish study-variation fraction from tolerance fraction.

title: 三次元量床校準
summary: 分清溫度修正值與修正後不確定度，避免認為軟體補償會消除所有熱誤差。
summaryEn: Separate temperature correction from residual uncertainty rather than assuming software removes all thermal error.

title: 雷射追蹤儀大尺寸量測
summary: 把角度誤差換成橫向位置誤差，建立測站配置的量化比較。
summaryEn: Convert angular error into transverse position error for quantitative station-layout comparison.

title: 工業斷層掃描檢測
summary: 區分體素取樣間距、空間解析度與缺陷可檢出性，不以一個體素保證看見缺陷。
summaryEn: Distinguish voxel sampling, spatial resolution and detectability rather than assuming one voxel guarantees a visible defect.

title: 工業設備預知保養
summary: 區分RMS、峰值及轉速條件，避免把任一特徵異常直接解讀成指定故障。
summaryEn: Distinguish RMS, peak and operating speed without assigning one feature uniquely to a fault.

title: 製造執行系統整合
summary: 用工作訂單、工件與事件識別碼區分新完工、重送及更正，避免重複計產。
summaryEn: Distinguish new completions, retries and corrections using order, part and eventIDs to avoid duplicate production counts.

title: 工廠數位分身驗證
summary: 區分程式是否解對方程與模型是否代表實體，避免只看平均誤差為零。
summaryEn: Distinguish solving equations correctly from representing reality, and avoid relying on zero mean error alone.

title: 柔性製造單元排程
summary: 在每件先M1後M2、每台同時一件的限制下比較完工時間，而非只排序單機工時。
summaryEn: Compare makespan under M1-before-M2 and one-job-per-machine constraints, not single-machine times alone.

title: 機械設備模組化設計
summary: 建立最壞情境公差鏈，區分可組裝、可定位及可互換三種要求。
summaryEn: Build a worst-case tolerance stack, distinguishing assembly, location and interchangeability.

title: 工業設備再製造
summary: 把材料保留率、再製能耗與壽命假設分開，避免用較少材料直接宣稱全生命週期較佳。
summaryEn: Separate retention, remanufacturing energy and lifetime assumptions instead of equating less material with a better life cycle.

title: 鑽孔蓄熱場熱傳模擬
subcategoryTitle: 機械、壓縮空氣與熱儲能
summary: 沒有合適含水層的地方，可以改用鑽孔蓄熱：在地下密密地鑽幾十到幾百個孔，每個孔裡插一根 U 形塑膠管，讓水在管內循環，把熱傳給周圍的土壤與岩石，或把熱取回來。被鑽孔包圍的整塊地層就是蓄熱體。加拿大安大略理工大學的鑽孔場有三百八十四個兩百多公尺深的孔。課程定量分析鑽孔長度、蓄熱體積與容量、熱擴散的尺度、表面積體積比、熱響應試驗與長期溫度漂移。
summaryEn: Where no suitable aquifer exists, borehole storage serves instead: tens to hundreds of holes drilled close together, each with a U-shaped plastic pipe through which water circul…

title: 冰水蓄冷與尖峰負載移轉
titleEn: Ice Thermal Storage and Peak Load Shifting
subcategoryTitle: 機械、壓縮空氣與熱儲能
summary: 大樓的冷氣是夏季用電尖峰的主因。儲冰空調在夜間電價便宜、電網輕載的時候啟動冷凍機，把水槽裡的水結成冰；白天需要冷氣時讓冰融化，冷凍機就可以少開或不開。紐約的美國銀行大樓在地下室裝了四十四座儲冰槽。課程定量分析潛熱蓄冷量與所需體積、製冰時的效率下降、移轉的電量與電費、需量費的節省、主機容量的縮減與電網層級的效益。
summaryEn: Air conditioning of large buildings is the main cause of summer demand peaks. Ice storage runs chillers at night, when power is cheap and the grid lightly loaded, to freeze wate…

title: 相變材料蓄熱模組設計
titleEn: Phase Change Material Thermal Storage Modules
subcategoryTitle: 機械、壓縮空氣與熱儲能
summary: 相變材料在熔化時吸收大量的熱、凝固時再放出來，而整個過程的溫度幾乎不變。石蠟、鹽類水合物與脂肪酸都可以當作相變材料；把它們封裝成模組，可以用在建築的蓄冷蓄熱、太陽能熱水、電池的溫控與工業餘熱的回收。它的最大弱點是導熱很差。課程定量分析潛熱與顯熱的比較、熔化所需的時間、鰭片的間距、體積膨脹、循環後的容量與儲熱密度。
summaryEn: A phase-change material absorbs much heat as it melts and gives it back on freezing, at almost constant temperature throughout. Paraffins, salt hydrates and fatty acids all serv…

title: 電網儲能電池管理系統
subcategoryTitle: 電池儲能電站與電池系統
subcategoryTitleEn: Battery storage plants and battery systems
summary: 電池管理系統量測每一顆電芯的電壓與溫度，估計還剩多少電、還有多少壽命，讓各電芯保持均衡，並在任何一顆越界時切斷電路；它是電池的大腦，也是最後一道電子防線。澳洲的維多利亞大電池在 2021 年試運轉時起火，原因之一就是那個機櫃的監控正好處於離線狀態。課程定量分析電壓誤差對荷電狀態的影響、被動均衡的時間、資料量、過充保護的時間餘裕與監控空窗。
summaryEn: A battery management system measures voltage and temperature of every cell, estimates charge and life remaining, keeps cells balanced and opens the circuit when any goes out of …

titleEn: Energy Storage Fault Isolation and Dispatch
subcategoryTitle: 電池儲能電站與電池系統
subcategoryTitleEn: Battery storage plants and battery systems
summary: 2019 年亞利桑那州一座 2 MWh 的儲能貨櫃裡，一顆電芯的內部故障引發了整個電池架的熱失控；滅火氣體撲滅了明火，卻留下滿貨櫃的可燃氣體，三小時後消防員打開門的瞬間發生爆燃。這起事故改寫了儲能的安全規範。課程定量分析排氣的濃度與爆炸下限、稀釋通風的風量、熔絲的動作、隔離故障後的剩餘容量與直流電弧的能量。

subcategoryTitle: 空間、邊緣與新型加速器
summary: 將可到達性、路徑長度及可用運算容量分開驗證，不能只以連通判定性能合格。
summaryEn: Verify reachability, path length and usable compute separately; connectivity alone is insufficient.

title: Groq LPU：靜態排程與資源衝突
titleEn: Groq LPU: static schedules and conflicts
subcategoryTitle: 空間、邊緣與新型加速器
summary: 以資源占用與資料到達時間檢查排程，將可預測性與絕對速度分開。
summaryEn: Check resource occupancy and data arrival, separating predictability from absolute speed.

title: Graphcore IPU：BSP 屏障與 tile 記憶體
titleEn: Graphcore IPU: BSP barriers and tile memory
subcategoryTitle: 空間、邊緣與新型加速器
summary: 以最慢tile計算時間加同步交換求超步長度，並檢查資料不能直接跨tile讀取。
summaryEn: Compute superstep duration from the slowest tile plus sync/exchange, and respect separate tile memories.

title: MIT Eyeriss：row-stationary 的資料搬移能量
subcategoryTitle: 空間、邊緣與新型加速器
summary: 把MAC、局部存取與DRAM存取分開計能，避免只看運算次數。
summaryEn: Account separately for MACs, local accesses and DRAM accesses rather than operation count alone.

title: NVDLA：卷積緩衝與 bank 配置
subcategoryTitle: 空間、邊緣與新型加速器
summary: 以bank為最小配置單位檢查雙緩衝，辨識容量足夠但bank分配不合法的情況。
summaryEn: Check double buffering at bank granularity, including configurations that fit by bytes but not by banks.

title: Google Coral Edge TPU：CPU 回退的臨界路徑
titleEn: Google Coral Edge TPU: CPU fallback critical paths
subcategoryTitle: 空間、邊緣與新型加速器
summary: 依時間與傳輸分析回退代價，不能以加速算子數比例估速度。
summaryEn: Analyze fallback by time and transfers, not the fraction of operator count accelerated.

title: Apple Core ML：Neural Engine 與裝置駐留
titleEn: Apple Core ML: Neural Engine and device residency
subcategoryTitle: 空間、邊緣與新型加速器
summary: 把允許使用某處理器與實際映射區分，對比核心時間及完整呼叫延遲。
summaryEn: Separate allowed processors from actual placement, and compare kernel time with complete call latency.

title: Intel Loihi 2：事件流與脈衝通信
titleEn: Intel Loihi 2: event streams and spike traffic
subcategoryTitle: 空間、邊緣與新型加速器
summary: 從神經元數、發放率與訊息大小推導流量，區分稀疏事件優勢及壅塞風險。
summaryEn: Derive traffic from neuron count, firing rate and message size, separating event sparsity from congestion risk.

title: 光子 tensor core：插入損耗與訊號預算
titleEn: Photonic tensor cores: insertion loss and signal budgets
subcategoryTitle: 空間、邊緣與新型加速器
summary: 把光學核心、光源與電子讀出分開，建立含損耗的功率預算。
summaryEn: Separate optical core, source and electronic readout, and build a loss-inclusive power budget.

title: IBM 類比記憶體運算：交叉陣列與電流加總
titleEn: IBM analog in-memory compute: crossbar current sums
subcategoryTitle: 記憶體階層與推論工作集
subcategoryTitleEn: Memory hierarchy and inference working sets
summary: 用歐姆定律與節點電流和重建二輸入內積，分開元件誤差與讀出誤差。
summaryEn: Reconstruct a two-input dot product using Ohm and Kirchhoff laws, separating device and readout errors.

title: PCM 類比AI：ADC量化與漂移誤差預算
titleEn: PCM analog AI: ADC quantization and drift budgets
subcategoryTitle: 記憶體階層與推論工作集
subcategoryTitleEn: Memory hierarchy and inference working sets
summary: 建立ADC半LSB與漂移的最壞誤差界，說明增加ADC位元不能消除元件漂移。
summaryEn: Budget half-LSB and drift errors, showing why more ADC bits do not remove device drift.

title: Roofline 經典：運算強度與可達性能
titleEn: The Roofline model: intensity and attainable performance
subcategoryTitle: 記憶體階層與推論工作集
subcategoryTitleEn: Memory hierarchy and inference working sets
summary: 以實際階層流量定義強度，判斷頻寬或計算限制，避免混用峰值及可持續頻寬。
summaryEn: Define intensity at one memory hierarchy and distinguish bandwidth from compute limits.

title: Triton GEMM：分塊重用與暫存容量
titleEn: Triton GEMM: tiled reuse and scratch capacity
subcategoryTitle: 記憶體階層與推論工作集
subcategoryTitleEn: Memory hierarchy and inference working sets
summary: 由tile形狀推導輸入bytes與FLOP，再檢查更大tile的暫存需求。
summaryEn: Derive input bytes and FLOPs from tile dimensions, then check scratch requirements for larger tiles.

title: CUDA 合併存取：有效bytes與交易bytes
titleEn: CUDA coalescing: useful bytes versus transaction bytes
subcategoryTitle: 記憶體階層與推論工作集
subcategoryTitleEn: Memory hierarchy and inference working sets
summary: 畫出每執行緒地址，計算實際交易與有用資料比例，避免把請求bytes當總流量。
summaryEn: Map thread addresses and distinguish useful requested bytes from transaction traffic.

title: CUDA 共享記憶體：bank衝突與padding
titleEn: CUDA shared memory: bank conflicts and padding
subcategoryTitle: 記憶體階層與推論工作集
subcategoryTitleEn: Memory hierarchy and inference working sets
summary: 以地址模bank數辨識衝突，區分不同地址衝突與同址廣播。
summaryEn: Use address modulo bank count to identify conflicts, distinguishing different-address conflicts from broadcast.

title: Triton fused softmax：中間張量消除
subcategoryTitle: 記憶體階層與推論工作集
subcategoryTitleEn: Memory hierarchy and inference working sets
summary: 列出每個中間張量的讀寫，驗證融合後數值穩定性與流量降低。
summaryEn: List reads/writes for intermediates, and verify stable numerical results after fusion.

title: FlashAttention：分塊與注意力矩陣物化
subcategoryTitle: 記憶體階層與推論工作集
subcategoryTitleEn: Memory hierarchy and inference working sets
summary: 分開score工作集、其他QKV資料與總計算量，避免把省記憶體誤稱次二次方精確注意力。
summaryEn: Separate score storage, QKV data and total work; memory savings do not make exact dense attention subquadratic.

title: vLLM KV cache：長上下文容量推導
subcategoryTitle: 記憶體階層與推論工作集
subcategoryTitleEn: Memory hierarchy and inference working sets
summary: 將層數、KV頭數、頭維度、token數及位元組數逐項核算。
summaryEn: Account for layers, KV heads, head width, tokens and bytes per value individually.

title: PagedAttention：分頁碎片與可分享前綴
subcategoryTitle: 記憶體階層與推論工作集
subcategoryTitleEn: Memory hierarchy and inference working sets
summary: 按每請求向上取整頁數，分開內部碎片、頁表及共享前綴的節省。
summaryEn: Round pages per request, separating internal waste, page tables and prefix-sharing savings.

title: GQA 推論部署：KV 頭分組與快取節省
titleEn: Deploying GQA: KV-head grouping and cache savings
summary: 明確區分query頭與KV頭，計算分組後快取，避免只改配置而不改模型。
summaryEn: Distinguish query heads from KV heads and calculate cache savings without treating configuration changes as model conversion.

title: Megatron 張量平行：分片收益與通訊成本
titleEn: Megatron tensor parallelism: shards and communication
summary: 在減少單卡計算的同時加上必要collective，判斷平行度提高是否仍有收益。
summaryEn: Add required collectives to reduced per-device compute and evaluate increasing parallelism.

title: Megatron 流水線：microbatch 與空泡
summary: 從完整時間表導出利用率，清楚區分此模型與含反向及optimizer的訓練排程。
summaryEn: Derive utilization from a complete timeline and distinguish the model from training schedules.

title: NCCL ring all-reduce：位元組與延遲模型
titleEn: NCCL ring all-reduce: byte and latency models
summary: 分清collective語意與具體演算法，計算每rank傳輸量及小訊息延遲項。
summaryEn: Separate collective semantics from algorithm choice, and calculate per-rank bytes and latency.

title: 梯度bucket：通訊重疊與尾端拖延
titleEn: Gradient buckets: overlap and communication tails
summary: 從資料真正就緒時刻排程，避免把尚未產生的梯度提前通訊。
summaryEn: Schedule from actual readiness, never communicating gradients before production.

title: Apache TVM MetaSchedule：調參成本與回本
titleEn: Apache TVM MetaSchedule: tuning cost and amortization
summary: 把一次性編譯成本與每次執行節省分開，保留目標裝置及形狀的有效範圍。
summaryEn: Separate one-time tuning from per-run savings and retain target/shape validity.

title: TensorRT 動態形狀：profile與最大記憶體
titleEn: TensorRT dynamic shapes: profiles and peak memory
summary: 將MIN、OPT、MAX與實際形狀分開，測試邊界而非只測OPT。
summaryEn: Separate MIN, OPT, MAX and runtime shapes, and test boundaries beyond OPT.

title: ONNX Runtime：execution provider圖分割
summary: 檢查每個算子的實際provider與張量駐留，找出碎裂分區的傳輸成本。
summaryEn: Inspect actual providers and tensor residency to identify fragmented-partition costs.

title: ONNX I/O Binding：資料駐留與複製節省
titleEn: ONNX I/O Binding: residency and copy avoidance
summary: 只消除可省的複製，不把初始上傳或最後下載排除在使用者延遲之外。
summaryEn: Remove only avoidable copies, without hiding initial upload/final download from user latency.

title: WebGPU 瀏覽器AI：workgroup限制與回退
titleEn: WebGPU browser AI: workgroup limits and fallback
summary: 以實際adapter限制選tile，對缺少能力或device lost提供可用回退。
summaryEn: Choose tiles from actual adapter limits and handle unavailable features or device loss with fallback.

title: LiteRT INT8：零點、尺度與量化誤差
titleEn: LiteRT INT8: zero points, scales and quantization error
summary: 正確處理零點與範圍，量化前後誤差按同一實值尺度比較。
summaryEn: Handle zero point and range correctly, and compare quantization errors in real-value units.

title: AWQ／TinyChat：INT4群組尺度與真實模型容量
titleEn: AWQ/TinyChat: INT4 group scales and real storage
summary: 區分位元打包權重、尺度、中繼資料與執行暫存，不用參數數乘4bit當完整需求。
summaryEn: Separate packed weights, scales, metadata and runtime workspace rather than counting only4-bit parameters.

title: cuSPARSE CSR：稀疏格式的容量損益
summary: 包含索引計算容量，保留空列與列偏移的正確性。
summaryEn: Include indices in capacity and preserve empty-row/offset correctness.

title: 推測式解碼：接受率與驗證回合
titleEn: Speculative decoding: acceptance and verification rounds
summary: 區分提出token、接受token與最終輸出，計入草稿成本及正確拒絕修正。
summaryEn: Distinguish proposed, accepted and emitted tokens, including draft cost and rejection correction.

title: vLLM 連續批次：Little定律與入場控制
titleEn: vLLM continuous batching: Little law and admission
summary: 使用同一系統邊界量測到達率與逗留時間，推導平均在系統請求數。
summaryEn: Measure arrival rate and residence time within one boundary to derive average requests in system.

title: MLPerf 式尾延遲：百分位與負載條件
titleEn: MLPerf-style tail latency: percentiles and load
summary: 明定百分位算法及樣本邊界，避免用平均值宣稱所有請求達標。
summaryEn: Declare percentile method/sample boundary and avoid using means to claim universal compliance.

title: MLPerf Power 觀念：每token能量與完整系統
titleEn: MLPerf Power principles: energy per token and system boundaries
summary: 使用同段時間的能量與有效輸出數，分開牆端功率、GPU讀值及額定TDP。
summaryEn: Use matched energy/output intervals, separating wall power, GPU telemetry and rated TDP.

title: GPU 持續負載：時脈、熱降頻與有效吞吐
titleEn: GPU sustained load: clocks, thermal throttling and throughput
summary: 使用整段產出計算平均吞吐，辨識溫度、功率限制與資料飢餓的不同證據。
summaryEn: Compute whole-run throughput and distinguish thermal, power and supply-starvation evidence.

title: Safetensors 模型交付：分塊續傳與完整性
titleEn: Safetensors delivery: chunked resume and integrity
summary: 區分格式安全、檔案完整性、來源可信與使用授權，不將檔名或雜湊當成全部信任。
summaryEn: Separate format safety, integrity, provenance and authorization rather than trusting filenames or hashes alone.

title: AI 加速器巨作總驗收：學徒導師的有效服務量
titleEn: AI-accelerator capstone: useful service for an apprentice mentor
summary: 將正確、具來源且準時的回答計為有效服務，避免只以生成token速度排名。
summaryEn: Count correct, sourced, on-time answers as useful service rather than ranking by token speed alone.

title: SQLite：JOIN 重複列與基數守恆
subcategoryTitle: 關聯模型與 SQL 系統
summary: 建立顧客、訂單與明細三張表，先預測 JOIN 列數，再比較營收聚合。
summaryEn: Build customer, order and line tables; predict join cardinality before aggregating revenue.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: PostgreSQL／SQLite：NULL 與三值邏輯
titleEn: PostgreSQL / SQLite: NULL and three-valued logic
subcategoryTitle: 關聯模型與 SQL 系統
summary: 為缺測溫度建立 TRUE、FALSE、UNKNOWN 真值表，確認 WHERE 與 COUNT 的行為。
summaryEn: Build TRUE,FALSE,UNKNOWN tables for missing temperatures and distinguish WHERE from COUNT.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: SQLite：外鍵、孤兒列與匯入順序
titleEn: SQLite: foreign keys, orphans and import order
subcategoryTitle: 關聯模型與 SQL 系統
summary: 對學員與選課資料建立外鍵，驗證匯入失敗可以回復整批。
summaryEn: Create student/enrolment foreign keys and verify batch import rollback.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: 關聯正規化：訂單功能相依與無損分解
titleEn: Relational normalization: dependencies and lossless decomposition
subcategoryTitle: 關聯模型與 SQL 系統
summary: 從重複顧客地址的訂單表找出更新異常，再以鍵驗證分解。
summaryEn: Find update anomalies in orders repeating customer addresses, then validate decomposition using keys.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: PostgreSQL：CHECK 約束與金額定點表示
titleEn: PostgreSQL: CHECK constraints and fixed-point amounts
subcategoryTitle: 關聯模型與 SQL 系統
summary: 設計價格、數量與折扣的資料契約，用整數分避免二進位小數累積歧義。
summaryEn: Define price, quantity and discount contracts using integer cents to avoid binary-fraction ambiguity.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: SQLite：遞迴 CTE 與循環組織圖
titleEn: SQLite: recursive CTEs and cyclic organization graphs
subcategoryTitle: 關聯模型與 SQL 系統
summary: 列出從 A 可到達的所有工程相依，並讓循環輸入仍然終止。
summaryEn: Enumerate all engineering dependencies reachable from A while ensuring cyclic input terminates.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: SQL 視窗函數：排名、同分與 ROWS 框架
titleEn: SQL windows: ranking,ties and ROWS frames
subcategoryTitle: 關聯模型與 SQL 系統
summary: 對同分成績比較 ROW_NUMBER、RANK、DENSE_RANK，並核對累積總分。
summaryEn: Compare ROW_NUMBER,RANK,DENSE_RANK on ties and reconcile running totals.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: SQLite：UPSERT 與重播匯入冪等性
subcategoryTitle: 關聯模型與 SQL 系統
summary: 用來源事件 ID 作唯一鍵，證明重跑匯入不重複計費。
summaryEn: Use source event IDs as unique keys and prove replay does not double-charge.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: MySQL／PostgreSQL：鍵集分頁與穩定排序
titleEn: MySQL / PostgreSQL: keyset pagination and stable order
subcategoryTitle: 關聯模型與 SQL 系統
summary: 比較 OFFSET 與鍵集分頁在新資料插入後是否跳列或重複。
summaryEn: Compare OFFSET and keyset pagination after concurrent inserts for omissions and duplicates.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: SQLite：SQL 集合差異與回歸比對
titleEn: SQLite: SQL set differences and regression checks
subcategoryTitle: 關聯模型與 SQL 系統
summary: 在查詢改寫前後同時核對多重集合與 NULL，避免只比總筆數。
summaryEn: Compare multisets and NULLs before and after query rewrites rather than checking row counts alone.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: SQLite：轉帳交易的原子性與 rollback
summary: 建立兩個帳戶並在扣款後故意拋出錯誤，證明交易未部分生效。
summaryEn: Create two accounts and inject an exception after debit to demonstrate all-or-nothing effects.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: PostgreSQL：Read Committed 的陳述式快照
titleEn: PostgreSQL: statement snapshots at Read Committed
summary: 用兩個工作階段追蹤同一交易內兩次 SELECT 可能看見不同已提交值。
summaryEn: Trace how two SELECTs inside one transaction can see different committed values across sessions.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: MVCC：版本可見性與長交易保留成本
titleEn: MVCC: version visibility and long-transaction retention
summary: 建立簡化版本生命週期，求兩個快照各自可見的資料與清理安全界線。
summaryEn: Model version lifetimes and derive visibility and safe reclamation for two snapshots.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: PostgreSQL：快照隔離下的 write skew
titleEn: PostgreSQL: write skew under snapshot isolation
summary: 重現兩位值班員各自離線後違反至少一人值班的不變量。
summaryEn: Reproduce two operators independently going off call and violating the at-least-one-on-call invariant.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: MySQL InnoDB：鎖順序與 deadlock 圖
titleEn: MySQL InnoDB: lock ordering and deadlock graphs
summary: 把兩個轉帳交易的等待關係畫成有向圖，找出可避免的鎖循環。
summaryEn: Draw wait-for edges for two transfers and identify an avoidable lock cycle.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: SQLite WAL：讀者快照與 checkpoint 界線
titleEn: SQLite WAL: reader snapshots and checkpoint boundaries
summary: 以兩連線觀察 WAL 模式的讀者與寫者並行，確認 checkpoint 不能破壞舊讀者。
summaryEn: Observe readers and writers with two WAL connections and verify checkpoints preserve old snapshots.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: PostgreSQL WAL：先寫日誌與 redo 邊界
titleEn: PostgreSQL WAL: write-ahead ordering and redo boundaries
summary: 以 LSN 簡化模型推演三個當機點，判斷頁面更新是否可復原。
summaryEn: Use a simplified LSN model to analyze three crash points and recoverability.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: SQLite SAVEPOINT：局部失敗與批次回復
titleEn: SQLite SAVEPOINT: partial failure and batch rollback
summary: 在外層交易中處理三個子批次，讓一個失敗只回復自己的寫入。
summaryEn: Process three sub-batches inside an outer transaction and roll back only the failed sub-batch.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: 資料庫樂觀鎖：version compare-and-swap
summary: 讓兩個編輯者用同一版資料提交，僅允許第一個更新成功。
summaryEn: Have two editors submit from the same version and allow only the first update to succeed.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: 交易 outbox：資料提交與事件送達的分界
titleEn: Transactional outbox: database commit versus event delivery
summary: 把訂單和待發事件同交易寫入，再用可重播 dispatcher 避免提交與傳送間遺失。
summaryEn: Write an order and pending event atomically,then use a replayable dispatcher to avoid gaps between commit and send.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: B+ 樹：頁容量、扇出與高度模型
titleEn: B+ trees: page capacity,fanout and height
summary: 從頁大小與 entry 大小估算扇出，區分內節點與葉節點的容量。
summaryEn: Estimate fanout from page and entry sizes while separating internal and leaf capacities.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: SQLite：複合索引的前綴與排序
summary: 比較 (department,score) 索引對雙條件查詢與只查 score 的差異。
summaryEn: Compare a (department,score) index for two-column predicates versus score-only queries.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: SQLite：covering index 與回表成本
titleEn: SQLite: covering indexes and table-lookup cost
summary: 將查詢所需欄位加入索引，量化避免回表的教學成本而不誤當實測加速。
summaryEn: Include projected fields in an index and quantify modeled avoided lookups without claiming measured speedup.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: SQLite：partial index 與可證明的條件
titleEn: SQLite: partial indexes and provable predicates
summary: 對少量待處理任務建立部分索引，驗證查詢條件涵蓋索引條件。
summaryEn: Create a partial index for sparse pending tasks and verify predicate compatibility.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: PostgreSQL：BRIN、相關性與 block 摘要
summary: 用每區塊 min/max 模型判斷時間條件可跳過多少區塊。
summaryEn: Use block min/max summaries to identify blocks skippable by a time predicate.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: PostgreSQL：hash join 的記憶體與 spill
summary: 用小表建 hash 與大表 probe，分析容量不足時為何需要分割。
summaryEn: Build a hash table on the small relation and probe with the large one,then analyze capacity-driven partitioning.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: 查詢最佳化：選擇性相依與估計誤差
titleEn: Query optimization: correlated predicates and estimation error
summary: 設計完全相關的城市與郵遞區號，展示獨立性假設如何低估列數。
summaryEn: Construct perfectly correlated city/postal attributes to expose independence-estimation errors.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: SQLite：expression index 與可索引運算式
titleEn: SQLite: expression indexes and indexable expressions
summary: 對 abs(amount) 建索引，測試等價但不同語法是否獲得相同計畫。
summaryEn: Index abs(amount) and test whether mathematically equivalent syntax yields the same plan.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: LSM-tree：寫入放大與 compaction 合併
titleEn: LSM trees: write amplification and compaction merges
summary: 追蹤同一 key 跨 SSTable 的版本，合併時只保留符合快照政策的最新值。
summaryEn: Trace key versions across SSTables and merge according to snapshot retention policy.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: Bloom filter：誤判率與不准假陰性
titleEn: Bloom filters: false positives without false negatives
summary: 建立 bit array 與固定雜湊位置，測試不存在 key 的誤判及已插入 key 的保證。
summaryEn: Build a bit array with fixed hash positions and test false positives while retaining inserted-key membership.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: Lamport clock：因果順序與不可逆推論
titleEn: Lamport clocks: causality and the invalid converse
summary: 依傳送、接收與本地事件重算邏輯時鐘，分清時間戳較小與因果較早。
summaryEn: Recompute logical clocks for sends,receives and local events,and distinguish timestamp order from causality.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: Vector clock：並行版本與逐分量比較
titleEn: Vector clocks: concurrent versions and componentwise order
summary: 用二節點版本向量辨識先後與並行，避免以字典序掩蓋衝突。
summaryEn: Use two-node vectors to distinguish precedence from concurrency rather than hiding conflicts by lexicographic sorting.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: Raft：多數法定人數與交集
summary: 枚舉五節點所有三節點集合，證明任何兩個多數集合至少交一節點。
summaryEn: Enumerate all three-of-five quorums and show any two share at least one node.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: Raft：日誌衝突與已提交前綴
titleEn: Raft: log conflicts and committed prefixes
summary: 用 index/term 表追蹤 follower 與 leader 的衝突位置，修復未提交尾端。
summaryEn: Trace index/term conflicts between follower and leader and repair an uncommitted suffix.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: Paxos：promise、accepted 與提案值繼承
titleEn: Paxos: promises,accepted values and value inheritance
summary: 在三個 acceptor 的 Phase 1 回覆中選擇必須繼承的值。
summaryEn: Choose the value a proposer must inherit from Phase 1 responses of three acceptors.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: ZooKeeper：session、ephemeral 節點與 fencing
summary: 描述持鎖程序暫停後 session 過期，再恢復時如何阻止過期寫入。
summaryEn: Model a paused holder whose session expires and show how to reject stale writes after it resumes.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: CRDT G-counter：逐節點累計與冪等合併
titleEn: CRDT G-counters: per-node totals and idempotent merge
summary: 以分量最大值合併離線計數器，驗證交換律、結合律與冪等性。
summaryEn: Merge offline counters by componentwise maxima and verify commutativity,associativity and idempotence.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: CAP：網路分割時的讀寫契約
summary: 透過兩區分割情境說明一致讀取與所有請求成功無法同時承諾。
summaryEn: Use a two-region partition to expose conflicting promises of consistent reads and universal success.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: 一致性雜湊：ring、虛擬節點與搬移集合
titleEn: Consistent hashing: rings,virtual nodes and moved keys
summary: 把鍵映到 token ring，新增節點後列出真正改變 owner 的鍵。
summaryEn: Map keys onto a token ring and enumerate ownership changes after adding a node.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: Chandy–Lamport：分散式 snapshot 與在途訊息
summary: 建立兩程序轉帳事件，保存局部狀態之外還需記錄在途訊息。
summaryEn: Build a two-process transfer trace showing why snapshots need in-flight messages as well as local state.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: Apache Kafka：partition offset 與消費進度
titleEn: Apache Kafka: partition offsets and consumer progress
summary: 以每 partition 的 next offset 計算 lag，辨識消費進度不是跨 partition 全域序。
summaryEn: Compute lag from each partition’s next offset and distinguish per-partition progress from global order.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: Kafka：at-least-once 重播與副作用去重
titleEn: Kafka: at-least-once replay and side-effect deduplication
summary: 比較先做副作用再提交 offset 與相反順序的當機結果。
summaryEn: Compare crash outcomes when effects precede offset commits versus the reverse.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: Apache Flink：event time、watermark 與遲到資料
titleEn: Apache Flink: event time,watermarks and late data
summary: 以亂序事件建立 tumbling window，追蹤 watermark 如何界定完成與遲到。
summaryEn: Build tumbling windows from out-of-order events and trace completion and lateness via watermarks.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量

title: Apache Beam：固定窗、滑動窗與重複歸屬
titleEn: Apache Beam: fixed/sliding windows and multiple membership
